from cloudpdf import CloudPDFClient
from cloudpdf import CloudPDFClient, AnnotationRef_ObjectNumber, PageRef

client = CloudPDFClient(
    token="<token>",
)

client.doc.annotations.reorder(
    doc_id="docId",
    layer_name="layerName",
    page_key="pageKey",
    refs=[
        AnnotationRef_ObjectNumber(
            page=PageRef(
                kind="objectNumber",
                object_number=1,
            ),
            object_number=1,
        )
    ],
    position="start",
)

java.source:
import com.cloudpdf.api.CloudPDFClient;

CloudPDFClient client = CloudPDFClient
    .builder()
    .token("<token>")
    .build();

client.doc().annotations().reorder(
    "docId",
    "layerName",
    "pageKey",
    DocAnnotationsReorderRequest
        .builder()
        .position(
            AnnotationPosition.of(AnnotationPositionZero.START)
        )
        .refs(
            Arrays.asList(
                AnnotationRef.objectNumber(
                    AnnotationRefObjectNumber
                        .builder()
                        .page(
                            PageRef
                                .builder()
                                .kind(PageRefKind.OBJECT_NUMBER)
                                .objectNumber(1)
                                .build()
                        )
                        .objectNumber(1)
                        .build()
                )
            )
        )
        .build()
);
